method.retrieval: current strict-AND FTS plus mandatory policies and authorized curated graph expansion; no ranking changes
method.full_document: all manifest-authorized applicable verified records via get(byte_limit=32768); no task filtering; fixture bodies below cap
method.byte_measurement: UTF-8 application envelope {ok,data}; summed per get for full-document; excludes JSON-RPC framing and duplicate MCP text content
method.tokens: ceil(serialized UTF-8 bytes / 3) per task observation, conservative estimate, not model tokens
method.mandatory_policy_recall: visible mandatory result OR explicit policy issue OR omitted-mandatory blocking reference; separate from normative compliance
method.aggregation: micro recall over annotated record-task pairs; empty denominators null; expected error cases excluded from recall denominators
method.latency: one sequential sample per case, service before MCP before full-doc; setup excluded; no timing CI threshold
